answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President; quoted by Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01.
answer.new_information: Weeks said Corning is in its fastest growth period and will probably double its size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part of them in America. The period is only described as “over the coming years”; “size” is undefined, and this is a management outlook rather than a reported result. The separate Fox News claims about the NVIDIA-Corning facilities and expected jobs are not the same claim as this outlook.
